plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: English (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] Complete 14 hours of a foreign language through the intermediate level. If you choose to enroll in a language you have studied previously without receiving college credit, you must first take a placement test. See academic advisor.
[grid1 fn3] Middle School Certificate seekers should consult an undergraduate English advisor for required courses.
[grid1 fn4] At least 3 hours must be in MATH. Three hours may be PHIL 240 .
[grid1 fn5] Select from ENGL 100-499 and LING 200-499. (except ENGL 103 , ENGL 104 , and ENGL 203 ).
[grid1 fn6] Select from any 100-499 course not used elsewhere (except ENGL 100-299). Up to 18 hours of ENGL 300-499 courses may be used. Only 14 hours of KINE 199 ; AERS 100-499, MLSC 100-499; NVSC 100-499; SOMS 100-499 may be used towards general electives.
